issues.title: Coupon not applying at checkout
issues.problem_statement: The customer's coupon code was not applying at checkout and showed "Invalid coupon" when used on the Advanced Course.

issues.title: Wrong company name on invoice (GST part)
issues.problem_statement: The company name shown in the GST part of the customer's invoice is wrong.

issues.title: Extend coupon expiry date
issues.problem_statement: The customer wanted to extend the expiry date of their coupon.

items.description: Support explained that in the coupon dashboard the coupon was assigned only to the Starter Course and not the Advanced Course, so the product needed to be assigned.
evidence: Coupon dashboard mein ye coupon sirf Starter Course ke liye assign hai, Advanced Course ke liye nahi.

items.description: Customer edited the coupon, selected the Advanced Course in the Products section and saved it, following support's guidance, and confirmed the discount now shows at checkout.
evidence: Ho gaya. Ab test karta hoon... haan, ab checkout pe discount dikh raha hai.

items.description: Support will check the invoice's company name issue with the billing team and tell the customer.
evidence: Uske liye main billing team se check karke aapko kal tak bata dunga.
items.stated_timeline: kal tak (by the day after the call)

items.description: Support explained that the customer can extend the coupon expiry date themselves in the coupon settings, where the date option is.
evidence: Expiry aap khud coupon settings mein badha sakte ho, wahin date ka option milega.

items.description: Customer will extend the coupon expiry date in the coupon settings.
evidence: Haan, main aaj raat badha dunga.
items.stated_timeline: aaj raat (the night of the call)

skip_recommendation.explanation: Complete support call with clear outcomes.
